content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The trade-specific graphics and clear call button work well, but the tall hero and repetitive contact-heavy ending make the page longer than necessary.",
  "desktopNote": "The oversized masthead, headings and footer branding overwhelm an otherwise coherent plumbing-specific visual system.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop masthead and headline sizes, and replace the enormous footer business name with a compact wordmark.",
    "Tighten the phone hero’s vertical gaps and radiator area, and reduce excessive desktop padding around the lower sections.",
    "Keep one complete contact section at the bottom and limit the footer to business registration details and utility links."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the footer repeats the address and phone details immediately after the dedicated contact section."
  ]
}
